abjure: Ab + jurare: swear off. Abjure violence.
afford: Ad + forth: bring forth. Trees afford shade.
aplomb: A plomb: plumb-straight. Handled it with aplomb.
appropriate: Ad + proprius: make own. Appropriate funds.
autocratic: Auto + kratos: self rule. An autocratic boss.
bridle: Bridle: horse strap. Bridle at orders.
complicit: Com + plicare: folded together. Complicit in fraud.
conflagration: Con + flagrare: burn. The city conflagration.
conflate: Con + flare: blow together. Conflate two ideas.
desideratum: Desiderare: long for. A key desideratum.
discursive: Dis + currere: run about. A discursive talk.
doughty: Dugan: be strong. A doughty fighter.
elegiac: Elegy: lament poem. An elegiac tone.
enormity: E + norma: outside the norm. The enormity of the crime.
gumption: Scots: common sense. Show some gumption.
impervious: In + per + via: no way through. Impervious to pleas.
impugn: In + pugnare: fight against. Impugn his motives.
internecine: Inter + necare: kill each other. Internecine feuds.
malingerer: Mal + malingre: sickly. A malingerer skips work.
obtuse: Obtusus: blunted. Too obtuse to see it.
panegyric: Pan + agora: assembly speech. A panegyric to him.
pellucid: Per + lucere: shine through. Pellucid prose.
proscribe: Pro + scribere: write publicly as banned. Proscribe drugs.
proselytize: Proselytos: convert. Proselytize door to door.
self-effacing: Efface: rub out. A self-effacing hero.
transmute: Trans + mutare: change across. Transmute lead to gold.
tyro: Tiro: recruit. A tyro in chess.
